workflow.action: Extensions UI quarantine with reason and exact package confirmation
workflow.result: success; dependent project and connection disclosed

defect_observation.expected: After unquarantine successfully clears the extension-installation kill switch, the Console badge reflects the fresh active inventory.
defect_observation.actual: The success screen briefly showed Kill Switch 1 while GET /admin/v1/kill-switches?active_only=true returned an empty list. The badge disappeared after navigating to Security and loading that list.
reproducible_steps: Quarantine the installed extension through Extensions UI.
Use the Extensions UI unquarantine action and observe its HTTP 200 INSTALLED_DISABLED response.
Observe the immediate success screen still shows a red Kill Switch 1 badge.
Navigate to Security → Kill Switches; the active_only=true response is empty and the badge clears.

limitations: No external provider call or paid provider usage.
No explicit permission-review, re-enable, reprobe, or restored-traffic workflow was attempted.
Stale ETag, unauthorized-role, multi-node, PostgreSQL, and failure-atomicity cases remain unverified.
Official RC7 release artifact and production signing remain unverified or blocked.
